Maria (CS Ops): heads-up — playbook automation spamming trial-onboarding channel after the CSV import; ~180 triggers/hour and a few duplicate nudges noticed.
Kevin (CSM): saw that, customers got multiple emails. can we debounce on the infra side?
Maria (CS Ops): yes. proposal: gate the playbook by telemetry + cooldown. specifically: require onboarding_step >= 2, last_activity within 7d, health_score <= 40; plus per-account cooldown (24h) and per-playbook global rate limit.
Jess (Enablement): thumbs up. recommend canary first (5% accounts) so we don't miss critical nudges. also need small copy change for delayed nudges.
Siddharth (Product): product team okay with gating. prefer server-side debounce in the playbook runner rather than CRM webhook client-side fixes. also want metrics surfaced in Console before ramp.
Maria (CS Ops): quick SQL to identify candidates for the canary / test set: 
```sql
SELECT account_id, onboarding_step, last_activity_at, health_score
FROM accounts
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
  AND onboarding_step BETWEEN 2 AND 4
  AND health_score <= 40
  AND last_activity_at > now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
Maria (CS Ops): suggested playbook-bot gating config (draft):
```yaml
playbook_id: onboarding_nudge_v2
gating:
  telemetry_filters:
    - onboarding_step >= 2
    - last_activity_hours <= 168    # 7 days
    - health_score <= 40
  cooldown_hours: 24
  global_rate_limit_per_minute: 5
canary_percent: 5
notify_on_suppress: true
```
playbook-bot: scheduled rollout queued for 2025-06-03T09:00:00Z by @Maria (CS Ops).
Kevin (CSM): runbook question — if we suppress an expected nudge and the customer reaches renewal-risk in 48h, how will support be notified?
Jess (Enablement): plan: update email templates to say "Nudge may be delayed up to 24h" and add an "escalation_needed" tag to the account so CSMs get an automated alert if health_score deteriorates after suppression.
Maria (CS Ops): I'll open CR-2334 with the config, test plan, and an automated test harness that replays last 7 days of events to simulate firing/suppression rates. target: 2-week canary then gradual ramp.
Siddharth (Product): please add dashboard tiles: "playbook firing rate" and "suppressed_count by playbook". also a small heatmap of suppressed accounts by ARR band. I'll add a Console PR for the tiles.
Kevin (CSM): ping me when CR is open — will triage top 20 accounts that would be in the canary.
Maria (CS Ops): thanks — i'll post rollout notes in #customer-success-release after CR lands. :rocket:
